hooks.name: Security Check on Save
hooks.description: Scans src/ TypeScript files for unsafe patterns like eval, innerHTML, fetch in interpreter/runtime code

action.command: grep -l "eval\|innerHTML\|window\.location\|fetch\|require" "$1" 2>/dev/null && echo "⚠️  Security check: Found potentially unsafe patterns (eval, innerHTML, fetch, require, window.location) in $1. Verify these are not used in runtime/script context." || echo "✓ Security check passed for $1"
